rawFindings.title: Invalid initialization of `valid` flag for `this` keyword under strict mode and globalReturn
rawFindings.explanation: The code change modifies the initialization of the 'valid' flag in the 'Program' visitor to include a check for the 'strict' mode of the scope and the presence of 'globalReturn'. It assumes 'scope.childScopes[0]' exists, but this might be undefined in some cases (e.g., empty childScopes array). Accessing 'scope.childScopes[0].isStrict' without checking if 'childScopes[0]' exists may cause a runtime error.
rawFindings.suggestion: Add a guard to confirm 'scope.childScopes.length > 0' before accessing 'scope.childScopes[0].isStrict'. For example, use a condition like 'features.globalReturn && scope.childScopes.length > 0 && scope.childScopes[0].isStrict' to avoid errors when 'childScopes' is empty.
rawFindings.failureAfterChange: When processing a Program node with an empty 'childScopes' array in the scope, the code throws a runtime TypeError due to accessing 'scope.childScopes[0].isStrict' without null check.
